phase: Phase 9: Convoy Situational Awareness, GPS Mesh Telemetry & Blackbox Voice Cache

stories.title: Offline Mesh Canned Hazard & Quick Text Messaging
stories.description: Implement MeshTextManager in commonMain supporting canned convoy messages (Fuel Needed, Road Hazard, Stop), custom text payloads, ACK receipts, and unread badge state.
acceptanceCriteria: Models MeshTextMessage with canned codes, custom text, timestamps, and delivery status
Supports direct peer-to-peer and group broadcast text frames
Automatic ACK receipt generation when target peer receives direct message
Thread-safe bounded in-memory message history with deduplication and unread counter
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Decentralized GPS Mesh Telemetry & Convoy Tracking
stories.description: Implement ConvoyGpsTracker in commonMain to beacon compact GPS coordinates over mesh control channels, calculate relative bearing and Great-Circle distance, and feed ProximityRadar.
acceptanceCriteria: Models GpsCoordinate with latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, bearing, and timestamp
Pure KMP Haversine distance and forward azimuth calculation with zero platform dependencies
Adaptive beaconing interval based on motion state (speed > 30 km/h vs stationary)
Feeds relative bearing and ground range directly into ProximityRadar targets
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Dynamic Adaptive Bitrate & Codec Profile Switching
stories.description: Implement AdaptiveBitrateController in commonMain to dynamically shift AudioProfile between ULTRA_LOW, LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH based on RfInterferenceDetector and MeshDiagnostics telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: Monitors real-time link margin and RF interference severity
Selects optimal AudioProfile balancing voice intelligibility against BLE collision risk
Hysteresis filter requiring 3 consecutive cycles before stepping down/up to avoid flapping
Emits reactive currentProfile StateFlow consumed by AudioEngine
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Rolling Emergency Voice Blackbox & Encrypted Incident Cache
stories.description: Implement EmergencyBlackboxRecorder in commonMain to capture a rolling 60-second in-memory circular audio buffer of emergency transmissions, generating encrypted incident forensic reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Rolling circular buffer preserving 60 seconds of compressed ADPCM audio frames
Automatic snapshot freeze upon EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE preemption or crash detection
Pure KMP ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption of incident report snapshots
Memory footprint strictly bounded (< 3 MB resident RAM)
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest
